text.title: C# Clean Architecture + CQRS Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema for the layered-solution manifest this methodology produces. Validator enforces required keys + per-field constraints.

section.title: Schema

example.code: { "solution_name": "Billing", "projects": { "Domain": {"references": []}, "Application": {"references": ["Domain"]}, "Infrastructure": {"references": ["Domain", "Application"]}, "Api": {"references": ["Application", "Infrastructure"]} }, "use_cases": [ {"feature": "Invoices", "name": "CreateInvoice", "command": "CreateInvoiceCommand", "handler": "CreateInvoiceHandler", "validator": "CreateInvoiceValidator", "response_dto": "CreateInvoiceResponse", "aggregate": "Invoice", "aggregate_has_public_setters": false, "handler_accepts_cancellation_token": true}, {"feature": "Invoices", "name": "GetInvoiceById", "command": "GetInvoiceByIdQuery", "handler": "GetInvoiceByIdHandler", "validator": "GetInvoiceByIdValidator", "response_dto": "InvoiceDetailDto", "aggregate": "Invoice", "aggregate_has_public_setters": false, "handler_accepts_cancellation_token": true} ], "layer_refs": {"domain_has_ef_ref": false, "domain_has_aspnet_ref": false, "application_has_ef_ref": false}, "pipeline_behaviour_order": ["Logging", "Validation", "Authorization", "UnitOfWork", "Caching"], "arch_tests_pass": true, "outbox_configured": true }

example.note: solution_name not PascalCase; Domain depends on Infrastructure (inversion); Application depends on Infrastructure; the use-case names a `Request` not a `Command`, a generic `OrderService` not a `Handler`, hand-rolled ifs instead of a Validator, an entity as the response DTO, an aggregate with public setters, and a `Handle` without a CancellationToken; Domain leaks EF + ASP.NET refs; arch tests failing; outbox missing.

list.item: Aggregate collection mutated externally (`user.Posts.Add(post)` instead of `user.AddPost(post)`).
`IgnoreQueryFilters()` outside an explicitly designated admin repository.
`IQueryable<T>` returned from an Application-layer handler or interface.
`DbContext` injected directly into a handler instead of `IApplicationDbContext`.
A Domain entity used as a controller return type, a MediatR response, or a Swagger schema.
A public setter (other than on `Id`) on a Domain aggregate.
One DTO shared across two queries with different projections.
